Happy to help! Do you have any other questions regarding college admissions or facilities?

Admissions for the upcoming academic session are currently open! You can apply online through the official college admission portal or collect the physical application form from the college administrative block (Counter 3) between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM.

General Eligibility Criteria:
- BCA / B.Sc: Minimum 50% aggregate in 10+2 (Higher Secondary) with Mathematics or Computer Science preferred from a recognized board (45% for reserved categories).
- B.Com / BBA: Minimum 45% aggregate in 10+2 in any stream.
- Merit lists are published based on qualifying 12th board examinations.

Our college offers the following programs:
1. Under-Graduate (UG):
   - Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - 3 Years
   - B.Sc. (Computer Science, IT, Mathematics) - 3 Years
   - Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - 3 Years
   - B.Com (General / Computer Applications) - 3 Years
2. Post-Graduate (PG):
   - Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - 2 Years
   - M.Sc. (Information Technology) - 2 Years

patterns: can i pay fees in installments
responses:
Fee Structure Summary (Annual):
- BCA: Rs. 45,000 per year (payable in 2 semester installments of Rs. 22,500).
- BBA: Rs. 40,000 per year.
- B.Sc: Rs. 35,000 per year.
- B.Com: Rs. 30,000 per year.
Fees can be paid online via Net Banking/UPI/Debit Card or through demand draft at the accounts counter.

Yes, our college provides multiple scholarship opportunities:
1. Merit Scholarship: Up to 25% tuition fee waiver for students scoring above 85% in 10+2.
2. State & Central Government Post-Matric Scholarships for SC/ST/OBC and minority students.
3. Sports Quota & Single Girl Child Scholarship.
Please visit the Scholarship Desk in Room 102 with your income certificate and mark sheets to apply.

College Schedule & Working Hours:
- Regular Classes: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
- Administrative Office: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM (Closed on 2nd and 4th Saturdays and public holidays).
- College Library: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM.

Examination Information:
- Odd Semester Exams (Sem I, III, V) are typically conducted in November - December.
- Even Semester Exams (Sem II, IV, VI) are held in April - May.
- Internal Assessments (CIE) are conducted twice per semester.
- Hall tickets/Admit cards are issued through the student portal 10 days before semester exams.

patterns: when will exam results be declared
responses: Exam results are announced within 4 to 6 weeks after exam completion on the official student portal (results section). Enter your Roll Number/University Registration Number to view grades. Revaluation applications must be submitted within 10 days of result announcement.

Mandatory Documents for Admission Verification:
1. 10th (Secondary) Marksheet and Passing Certificate.
2. 12th (Higher Secondary) Marksheet and Passing Certificate.
3. School/College Transfer Certificate (TC).
4. Migration Certificate (for non-state/CBSE/ICSE boards).
5. Character Certificate from the previous institution.
6. 4 passport-size photographs.
7. Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable).
8. Aadhar Card copy for identity and address proof.

patterns: how many books can i borrow
responses:
The Central Library features over 35,000 books, international research journals, magazines, and e-learning resources. Key highlights:
- Timings: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Extended till 7:00 PM during exam weeks).
- Book Quota: 3 books for UG students for a period of 14 days.
- High-speed Wi-Fi and 40-system Digital Library lab with DELNET and IEEE access.

Hostel Accommodations:
- Separate, secure hostels for boys and girls inside the campus.
- Facilities: Furnished 2-seater and 3-seater rooms, 24/7 security, high-speed Wi-Fi, hygienic mess providing 3 meals + evening tea, RO water, and solar water heaters.
- Hostel Fees: Rs. 65,000 per academic year (including food and lodging).
- Hostel Curfew: 7:30 PM for safety.

Training & Placement Cell:
- Our college maintains an 85%+ placement record for eligible graduates.
- Top Recruiters: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini, Tech Mahindra, Cognizant, and Amazon.
- Average Salary Package: Rs. 3.5 to 4.2 LPA; Highest Package: Rs. 9.5 LPA.
- We conduct pre-placement aptitude training, coding workshops, and mock interviews from the 4th semester.

Campus Life & Sports:
- Sports: Cricket ground, football turf, basketball court, badminton courts, and an indoor gym.
- Cultural Activities: Annual Inter-College Fest 'TechnoWave' held every February.
- Active student clubs: Coding Club, Robotics Society, Photography Club, NSS, and Rotaract.

College Contact Information:
- Campus Address: Apex Institute of Technology & Science, Knowledge Park, Sector 4, City Campus - 560001.
- Admission Helpline: +91 98765 43210 / +91 80 2345 6789
- Email: admissions@apexinstitute.edu.in | info@apexinstitute.edu.in
- Nearest Metro/Bus Station: Central Station (1.5 km away).
